decision: Use a Rust HTTP API behind OpenAPI for React clients
why: The platform plan and council favor one Rust domain for local and hosted financial rules

decision: Complete whole-period sales queries before drawer and refund reporting
why: This is a bounded fix for the 250-row cap and gives later financial reports an exact query base
result: complete; frontend build, native check, and sales report tests pass; visual review pending

decision: Keep unsupported provider requests in a local outbox until server acknowledgement
why: The desktop app has no authenticated operator API yet and must not claim local drafts reached the developer

decision: Pin the ticket to the viewport right edge and keep the catalog separate
why: The sidebar is the left workspace column, so its width must not be subtracted from the ticket right offset

decision: Replace the 250-row command with one store-scoped query for paged rows and full-filter aggregates
why: A per-store SQLite high-water mark keeps later inserts out of page navigation; one read transaction keeps each response internally consistent
result: frontend build, native check, and net refund report test pass; visual review pending

decision: Record only payment method kind and safe flags in audit details
why: The form accepts free text and must not copy merchant-account details into audit storage

decision: Use one audited station drawer with append-only movements and idempotent Z close
why: Cash expected is computed from the opening float, linked cash tenders, and signed cash movements; attendance remains independent
result: implemented; full native suite and migration chain pass; visual review pending

decision: Use sale-time item snapshots for quantity refunds and full voids
why: Refund amounts must preserve original tax, discount, and cost snapshots; stock, tender, cash ledger, sale state, and audit writes are atomic
result: implemented; full native suite, frontend build, and migration chain pass; visual review pending
